summary: Iteration 11 tested end-to-end: 18/18 backend pytest cases pass (POST /api/contact happy + 422 validation, GET /api/admin/contact-messages auth+newest-first+no _id leak, PATCH status happy/invalid/404, DELETE happy/404, PUT /api/admin/site-config google_reviews_url round-trip via GET /api/site-config, iter10 regression on /api/admin/images CRUD, /api/uploads/{name}, catalog GETs). Frontend /contact page: new phone +1 (242) 432-2587 and info@roxtaxi242.com visible, contact-form submits and confirmation card (data-testid=contact-form-sent) renders, google-reviews-card + google-reviews-cta present (target=_blank, href from site-config). /admin/manage Messages tab renders MessagesPanel with all 4 filter chips (all/new/replied/archived), rows expose message-reply/mark-replied/archive/reopen/delete testids, Reply mailto href is well-formed with subject+ref+greeting, Mark replied updates row badge to REPLIED via PATCH. Site Config tab shows site-google-reviews input persisted value; logo-pick-btn opens ImagePickerModal (Photo library). Nassau carousel Queen's Staircase image URL contains 'queens-staircase-nassau-66-steps' (verified in NassauCarousel.jsx line 34).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminManage.jsx is ~796 lines and hosts CatalogPanel, ImagesPanel, MessagesPanel, SiteConfigPanel — recommend splitting each panel into its own file under /components/admin/ for maintainability (>700-line threshold breached).
Delete row uses window.confirm(); consider a Radix AlertDialog to align with the rest of the shadcn UI and improve keyboard/a11y consistency.
MessagesPanel default filter appears to be 'new' — verify empty-state UX for 'replied'/'archived' filters when zero rows (a data-testid='messages-empty' state would help future test automation).
Contact.jsx Field component omits type/required attributes on the underlying inputs; adding aria-required and native required on name/email/message would improve a11y and browser validation UX.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_UI contact messages via POST /api/contact during UI tests (visible in Messages tab). One was marked replied via UI; pytest also created+deleted its own TEST_Alice message.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend suite with `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration11_contact_messages.py -n 0` because the file uses class-level state (created_id) that races under the default `-n 2 --dist loadscope` config in backend/pytest.ini. Frontend: /admin/login → admin@roxtaxi.com/admin123 → /admin/manage → tabs Tours/Taxi Services/Rentals/Images/Messages/Site Config are all data-testid='admin-tab-{key}'.
